theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dtfrpo_orthonormal_frame_sign
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (τ e : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Orthonormal ℝ e → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range e) → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, α τ = α e) ∨ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, α τ = -α e)
